items.headline: Corning announced a multibillion-dollar Amazon agreement to supply optical fiber, cable, and connectivity for U.S. data centers
Corning said NVIDIA will invest up to $3.2 billion to expand U.S. optical manufacturing for AI technologies
Corning launched Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3 for Motorola’s upcoming razr fold device
Corning and Meta announced a multiyear, up to $6 billion agreement to accelerate U.S. data center buildout
Corning’s board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.28 per share
